title: GTA6 Shadow Looms: Over 28 PS5 & PS Plus Games Coming Next Week
description: As we approach the GTA6 release window, November game releases are expected to dip. Check out the highlights for PS5 and PS Plus from Nov 2nd to 8th.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## The GTA6 Evacuation Zone: November Releases Slow Down

According to a recent report by gaming media outlet Push Square, we are rapidly approaching the "GTA6 evacuation zone." As the industry braces for the monumental launch of Rockstar Games' upcoming blockbuster, industry watchers and players alike should expect the number of new game releases to drop dramatically throughout November.

Publishers across the board appear to be steering clear of the colossal shadow cast by GTA6, creating a natural bottleneck in the late-year release calendar. However, despite the overarching slowdown, there is still a respectable wave of titles heading to PlayStation platforms in the coming days.

## Highlights for November 2nd to 8th

For the week spanning from November 2nd to November 8th, players can still look forward to a lineup of over 28 PS5 and PS Plus games. Among the noteworthy titles making waves this week are:

* **Zero Parades (PS5 Version)**: Bringing its distinct experience to Sony's current-generation console, the PS5 edition of Zero Parades stands out as one of the major releases of the week.
* **CRYMELIGHT**: This intriguing title brings an Alice in Wonderland-themed roguelite experience to players who enjoy challenging, run-based gameplay loops with a dark fantasy twist.
* **Godzilla: Destroy All Monsters!**: Monster-action fans will also find something to chew on as this title joins the weekly release schedule.

## Market Context and Expectations

The phenomenon of developers shifting their release dates away from massive tentpole games like GTA6 is a well-documented industry trend. While major publishers clear the runway, it often opens up a unique window for indie gems and distinct genres to capture attention without being completely overshadowed. Gamers looking to catch up on their backlog or try fresh experiences will find this transitional period quite welcoming.

## Editor's Take

While the looming presence of GTA6 is already reshaping the November release calendar with a dramatic dip in new titles, it's not all doom and gloom for PS5 owners. Taking time to check out unique offerings like the Alice in Wonderland roguelite CRYMELIGHT or the PS5 port of Zero Parades might just be the perfect way to spend the quiet weeks ahead.
